coordConventions.model_unity: -X left, +Y up, +Z front (left-handed glTFast; rot axis (bx,by,bz)->(+bx,-bz,+by))
coordConventions.local_blender: bone rest space (= glTF bone rest space; +Y head->tail)
coordConventions.local_unity: glTFast bone rest space for q_rel=Inverse(rest)*local (axis (lx,ly,lz)->(+lx,-ly,-lz))

Neck.note: +flex nod forward, +abduct tilt left, +twist turn left

Head.note: +flex nod forward, +abduct tilt left, +twist turn left

LeftArm.note: +flex swing forward, +abduct raise outward/up, -abduct adduct toward torso

LeftForeArm.note: hinge: +flex bend forearm forward (-Y), abduct locked 0, twist shared with ForeArmTwist1/2

LeftHand.note: +flex toward palm, -abduct radial (thumb), +abduct ulnar (pinky), twist redistributed to forearm twist bones

LeftUpLeg.note: +flex raise thigh forward, +abduct spread outward, -abduct adduct inward

LeftLeg.note: hinge: +flex bend knee backward (+Y), abduct locked 0, twist +-10 only while flexed > 20 deg

LeftToeBase.note: +flex dorsiflex toes up (stride push-off), -flex curl down

RightArm.note: +flex swing forward, +abduct raise outward/up, -abduct adduct toward torso

RightForeArm.note: hinge: +flex bend forearm forward (-Y), abduct locked 0, twist shared with ForeArmTwist1/2

RightHand.note: +flex toward palm, -abduct radial (thumb), +abduct ulnar (pinky), twist redistributed to forearm twist bones

RightUpLeg.note: +flex raise thigh forward, +abduct spread outward, -abduct adduct inward

RightLeg.note: hinge: +flex bend knee backward (+Y), abduct locked 0, twist +-10 only while flexed > 20 deg

RightToeBase.note: +flex dorsiflex toes up (stride push-off), -flex curl down
